name: Mathbarer Char

queries.query: Mathbarer Char Bangladesh cadastral parcel map official; Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel viewer Mathbarer Char
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) official Map Search, Integrated Online Map Purchase System, and the Ministry of Land Smart Map project. The sources describe official mouza/plot survey-map services, but the search results did not establish a local Mathbarer Char registry custodian or expose a parcel geometry response.

queries.result: First-party Bengali discovery identified the official DLRS Bengali Map Search and government land-map pages. The material confirms national mouza/plot map and survey-record functions, but did not identify a local Mathbarer Char custodian or safe parcel geometry/native identity.

registryEvidence.custodian: No city/local registry custodian was evidenced. DLRS is a national agency/service source, not proof of a Mathbarer Char local registry.
registryEvidence.locality: Mathbarer Char, Bangladesh; WUP point only.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: Official national cadastral/mouza-map services are evidenced; local custody and citywide parcel coverage remain unverified.

officialSources.observation: Official DLRS Bengali map-search page exposes division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet, and plot controls; retrieved request timed out before HTML/API inspection.
Official DLRS integrated map-purchase portal exposes CS, SA, RS, BRS, and BDS mouza-map search and a current maintenance message saying services are not officially launched.

Official Ministry of Land Smart Map page says mouza sheets are digitized and geo-referenced for mouza/plot-based land zoning; retrieved JavaScript contained no public parcel-vector endpoint in the landing page.
Official DLRS portal describes survey-map, khatian, ongoing-survey, and mouza-map services.
